slide_1.first_textbox: This case intentionally pushes content limits to validate overflow handling.
slide_1.first_bullet: When data dependencies are spread across external vendors, delayed contract updates can break ingestion pipelines and silently invalidate historical comparisons; teams must validate every interface revision.
slide_1.second_bullet: If model monitoring thresholds are copied from pilot environments without recalibration, false positives or missed incidents can increase sharply, forcing operations teams into reactive workflows that hide root causes.
slide_1.third_bullet: Large multi-country launches require local policy checks, language QA, and support playbooks; skipping any of these steps can produce inconsistent user outcomes and prolonged remediation timelines.
slide_1.second_textbox: Overflow behavior should stay readable even when ideal aesthetics are not possible.
